concerns.text: Task T021c implements a 'Random Forest Baseline' trained on 2D descriptors. Spec FR-004 and Plan 'Geometry Oracle' mandate a 'Geometry-Based Baseline' using RDKit's 3D conformer generation. T021c introduces an unmandated baseline and fails to satisfy the constitutional requirement (Principle VI) to compare 2D topology against a 3D geometry proxy. This is a semantic weakening of the core research requirement.

Task T028b implements a 'relative' MAE threshold sweep as a primary task. Spec FR-006 explicitly mandates sweeping 'absolute' thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} Å². While T028 covers absolute, T028b's framing as a primary task risks diluting the mandatory absolute sweep required by the spec, violating the constraint that the specific absolute values are the primary metric.

Task T052 hardcodes a '6-hour' CI limit for runtime verification. Spec SC-005 and Plan 'Performance Goals' state the limit is '[deferred]' or '< 4 hours'. Hardcoding a specific 6-hour value without spec amendment violates the constraint to defer empirical values in planning docs and contradicts the Plan's 4-hour goal.

Task T015 halts on >10% failure but lacks the explicit requirement from Plan T015 and Spec Edge Cases to 'generate and log the failure_report.csv analyzing properties of failed molecules'. The task description omits the deliverable artifact (failure_report.csv) required for the edge case handling.

Task T021b describes a 'Geometry-Based Baseline' but the description is ambiguous regarding the implementation of the 3D conformer generation on the *held-out test set* as mandated by Spec FR-004. It does not explicitly state that it computes SASA directly from geometry for the test set to serve as the ground-truth proxy, risking a semantic drift from the 'Geometry Oracle' definition in the Plan.
